description: `start multiverse`, with `[projects.multiverse]` omitting `path`, opens exactly one workspace for the hub (decided changes 1a-1c, `20261108-b-81cb2b`): `workspace create` labeled `multiverse` rooted at `<state dir>/home` (created since it did not exist — a missing hub home is created, never refused, unlike an ordinary project's missing path), the home seed written there, its Nexus pane split to the right with no focus (`pane split`), and a read-only `board --all --watch --read-only` watcher launched in the new pane (`pane run`). No account is configured, so no Nexus launches into the root pane. The strict scripted transcript below is exhaustive: no `tab list`/`tab create` call is scripted, so the hub opening a dashboard tab (it must not, ever) would fail this scenario rather than merely going unchecked. Exit EXIT_OK (0).
